description: GET one public-root card-v0 leaf by sha256 (64 hex) from https://councilof.ai/cards/{sha16}.json. UNMEASURED cells stay visible. States: VALID (fetched); NOT_IN_THIS_CORPUS (the id is in the signed card index, not the public root, so use verify_card on it); INVALID (in neither the live root nor the signed card index); UNCHECKABLE (a source could not be read). Not a GSPC measurement-card.

sha256.description: 64-char hex payload SHA-256 of the card-v0 leaf.

name: get_card

card_url.description: With NOT_IN_THIS_CORPUS: the signed card body to pass to verify_card.

corpus.description: With NOT_IN_THIS_CORPUS: the set the id belongs to (signed_card_index).

next.description: With NOT_IN_THIS_CORPUS: the tool call that checks this id.

title: One public-root card-v0 leaf
